messages:
Ara: Quick async check-in — yesterday: landed the initial eval harness for synthia-v2 and ran full-sweep on promptset `longform-news`, discovered a ~15% drop in ROUGE compared to baseline on long prompts. Pushed results to /evals/synthia-v2/run-230 and uploaded sample traces.
Mike: looking at the traces now. I see tokenizer mismatch artifacts in some examples (extra eos tokens). Re-ran a mini-batch and the generated length differs by ~3 tokens on average.
Sophia: FYI PR #421 (model-onboard/synthia-v2) is waiting on a couple of small comments from me. CI is flaky — `test_kv_cache` fails intermittently with an OOM on 8GB test node.
Ara: thanks. Blockers: 1) need a quick PR review on #421 (quant + tokenizer bits), 2) infra repro for the OOM. @Mike can you take the tokenizer check first? :eyes:
Mike: on it. Quick hypothesis: saved checkpoint used a different `eos_id` mapping than the tokenizer.json we shipped. I'll add a unit test in PR #422 to assert tokenizer/checkpoint alignment (`assert tokenizer.eos_token_id == ckpt.eos_id`).
Kai: small note — the `longform-news` promptset includes a few very long instruction prefixes; tokenizer truncation rules changed slightly after our tokenizer upgrade which could explain the ROUGE drop. Might be worth normalizing prompts before eval.
Sophia: I can try reproducing the OOM locally with a 16GB job. If I can repro, we should switch the canary to float16 path or smaller batch size.
Ara: good plan. Also there's a canary scheduled at 16:00 PT today for synthia-v2 on eng-ml-canary. If the evals still show regression we should abort the canary.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary synthia-v2 -> eng-ml-canary at 2023-10-22T16:00:00Z. Auto-abort threshold set: >2% val metric regression or >1.5x latency increase.
Jen: I can block out 2 hours after lunch to pair on the tokenizer sanity checks and PR comments. Ping me in thread when you want to pair. :+1:
Mike: opened PR #422 with the eos/tokenizer assertions and a tiny reproducer. Also requested a 16GB infra node from eng-infra.
Ara: plan for today: (A) pair Jen+Mike to land tokenizer fix, (B) Sophia repros OOM and reports whether float16 path is a viable immediate fallback, (C) rerun the eval harness after changes. If stable, proceed with canary; if not, abort and cut a smaller canary.
Sophia: no objections. If canary is risky, I'll request a limited traffic canary (10% of test traffic) so we can monitor without full blast.
Ara: perfect. Leaving async — I'll update when PRs land or infra repro is in. Thanks all. :sparkles:
Mike: will post quick follow-up once the unit test passes locally.
Jen: standing by, drop me a DM when ready.
